appContext.category: food waste reduction and kitchen inventory
appContext.summary: SAVEAT helps home cooks stop throwing away groceries. People scan the barcodes of food they buy, the app tracks what is in their fridge, freezer and pantry, warns them before items expire, and uses AI to suggest real meals cooked from what they already own, so they shop less and waste less.
forbiddenInterpretations: calorie counting or diet tracking app
personal finance or budgeting bank app

theme.style: A calm modern kitchen in soft daylight: warm cream and oat backgrounds, sage and deep herb greens, with a single amber accent like late-afternoon sun on a counter. Textures feel tactile and edible — matte paper, brushed ceramic, soft linen folds, gentle organic curves rather than hard geometry. Lighting is diffused and natural, coming from the upper left like a kitchen window, with airy negative space at the top so headlines breathe. Nothing shouts; the mood is reassuring, wholesome and quietly premium.
